_comment: Copy to data/config.json and edit. Everything here is also editable from the web UI; the UI writes this same file. All keys are optional — anything omitted falls back to the defaults in app/config.py.

loudness._comment: Per-track volume normalization (EBU R128). Each track is measured once in the background, then played at a fixed gain so loud songs are pulled down and quiet ones lifted. enabled=false keeps the legacy dynamic loudnorm chain. window_seconds is how much of the START of each file is analyzed (0 = the whole file); changing it re-measures the library. workers defaults to 2 and can also be set with VDJ_LOUDNESS_WORKERS in .env (raise it near your core count for a faster first pass).

icecast._comment: Icecast delivery for external players (Winamp / VLC / Sonos). The app runs a managed icecast2 and relays the stream into it. In Docker these come from the .env ICECAST_* / VDJ_ICECAST_* vars; on bare metal set them here. public_port must equal port for the single-container setup.

cache._comment: Temporary data is pruned automatically: the rendered DJ-line cache, TTS scratch and abandoned partial downloads. dj_keep_files is how many recent breaks stay, dj_max_age_hours/max_mb are additional ceilings (0 disables one), tmp_grace_minutes is how long a *.tmp/*.part file may sit before it counts as abandoned. The web UI's Library card shows the footprint and has a Clean now button (POST /api/cache/clean).

logging._comment: Console always; to_file also writes data/logs/virtual-dj.log, rotated at max_mb with this many backups. VDJ_LOG_LEVEL overrides the console level.
